name: Glycine
short: In a randomised trial in 214 heart patients, side effects with long-term oral glycine were similar to placebo. A small schizophrenia study found antipsychotic blood levels were not altered.
text: In a double-blind randomised trial in 214 patients scheduled for coronary angioplasty, there was no significant difference in side effects or in major adverse cardiac events between chronic oral glycine and placebo at follow-up. In a study of 12 people with schizophrenia given high-dose glycine in addition to antipsychotic treatment, most of whom were taking clozapine or olanzapine, serum antipsychotic levels were not significantly altered. No other interaction data were found in the cited sources.
